research_topic: Ultra-Low-Bit Quantized Diffusion Model Generation Quality Preservation Implement 2-bit Quantized Diffusion with Learnable Precision Allocation (2Q-DiffPA) using information-theoretic optimization to achieve 40% FID score improvement over existing quantization methods and 75% memory usage reduction on CIFAR-10, CelebA-64, and LSUN Churches-64, compared against 8-bit quantized diffusion models, BitsFusion, and standard DDPM baselines.
